description: Returns whether one CN/HS/TARIC code is covered by the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) Annex I, with the matching product lines and official sources. Use it to check a single code; use eudr_list_products to browse the whole Annex I catalogue, and cbam_get_default_values for CBAM, a different law. Input: cn (required, code or prefix, 2 to 10 digits, spaces and dots ignored, e.g. 0901 for coffee). Output: verdict (yes, partly, some_codes_below, applies_later or no), in_scope, meaning, matches[], upcoming[], removed products, applies_from, sources and verified. Annex I as amended by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/2102: cattle hides, skins and leather (4101, 4104, 4107) are removed (verdict no, with removed set); products it adds, such as soluble coffee 2101 11 00, apply only from 2027-12-30 and give applies_later with upcoming[]. some_codes_below means a longer code is needed; partly means an ex line where only the described goods are covered. Bundled from the official acts and reviewed as of verified; this is scope information, not a due-diligence statement. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free, as short samples (up to 3 records, without file proof, history or paging cursor) where a paid HTTP address exists (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors are free, and so are empty answers except a sanctions name search with no match when every loaded list it checks is fresh (lists not loaded yet are named in the answer). An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

cn.description: CN/HS/TARIC code or prefix, 2 to 10 digits after removing spaces and dots, e.g. 0901
